action_item_for_main_agent: 1. Rate limiting: Verify rate limiting implementation - test showed 6 failed login attempts did not trigger 429 status. May need to check if rate limit window expired or IP-based tracking is working correctly. 2. Restore API endpoints: /api/restore/ingredients and /api/restore/menus return 422 errors - API expects list directly as body parameter, which is unusual for FastAPI. Consider wrapping in a Pydantic model for better API design. 3. Print width selector: Could not verify if changing print width from 80mm to 58mm updates the receipt preview width dynamically - selector element was not found with data-testid. Verify selector is properly implemented.
